content: Delivered: Replaced kbs_init/kbs_insert/kbs_destroy in remove_alleles() with pure Rust KBitSet struct. RAII wrapper allocates a C-compatible kbitset_t via libc::malloc from a &[bool] slice, with correct slot count formula (ceiling division), sentinel mask (KBS_MASK(ni)-1), and n/n_max semantics (both store slot count). 5 differential tests verify bit-exact match against C kbs_* functions across empty/full/single-bit/boundary-crossing sizes. All 229 tests pass, clippy clean.
